origins.name: Subjugation
origins.description:
Weapon adapts to targets. When dealing damage:

• To weak targets: shots explode
• To strong targets: targets become exhausted
• To Guardians: the weapon's flinch resistance increases

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Pugilism
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

enhanced.name: Shoot to Loot
enhanced.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves. Increases range.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Tear
perks.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

enhanced.name: Tear
enhanced.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed. Cooldown between activations reduced.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

enhanced.name: Killing Tally
enhanced.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

enhanced.name: Target Lock
enhanced.description: Damage increases by an improved amount the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.

enhanced.name: Detonator Beam
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target. Triggers faster.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.
